_meta.source: Standard overcurrent device ratings per NEC 240.6(A).
_meta.caveat: The 'stocked' flag is a PTS PROCUREMENT PREFERENCE, NOT A CODE RULE. Every rating listed here is a standard size the NEC recognizes; the ones flagged false are the half-size ratings PTS does not use, so the tool steps past them to the next full size. Flip a flag to change what the app recommends - nothing else needs editing.
_meta.verify: Confirm the rating list against printed 240.6(A), and confirm the stocked flags against PTS practice. See VERIFICATION.md section 13.

smallConductorMaxOcpd._note: NEC 240.4(D)(3)-(7). These caps override ampacity: a conductor may not be protected above this rating no matter what Table 310.16 allows. These are the asterisked rows in Table 310.16.
